<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sour Rabbit 84</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by vinodjangid07 - https://uiverse.io/vinodjangid07/sour-rabbit-84 */
/* From Uiverse.io by vinodjangid07  - Tags: hover, checkbox, toggle, save, hover effect, pin, bookmark */
.container input {
  display: none;
}
.pin {
  width: 15px;
  height: auto;
  transform: rotate(35deg);
}
.container {
  width: 45px;
  height: 45px;
  background-color: transparent;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.container input:checked ~ .pin {
  fill: rgb(179, 139, 255);
  stroke: white;
}
.container input:checked ~ .pin line {
  stroke: rgb(179, 139, 255);
}
.container input:checked ~ .pin path {
  stroke: rgb(179, 139, 255);
}
.container:hover {
  background-color: rgb(244, 238, 255);
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.041);
}
.container:active {
  transform: scale(0.9);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<label class="container">
  <input type="checkbox" />
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    fill="none"
    viewBox="0 0 75 100"
    class="pin"
  >
    <line
      stroke-width="12"
      stroke="black"
      y2="100"
      x2="37"
      y1="64"
      x1="37"
    ></line>
    <path
      stroke-width="10"

    ></path>
  </svg>
</label>
</body>
</html>
